decision_question: Does the release-bound hybrid architecture preserve factual grounding while GPT-5.6 Terra plans complex reactive and proactive tutoring actions on fresh, source-disjoint cases?

hard_gates.name: all-responses-durable-before-gold
hard_gates.evidence: The response ledger reached completed with 820/820 unique responses before hidden gold was materialized.

hard_gates.name: flow-independent-case-classification
hard_gates.evidence: The scorer selected proactive cases by legacy case-ID prefixes; the fresh release-prefixed IDs therefore produced an empty denominator.

hard_gates.name: quality-gates-computed
hard_gates.evidence: A ZeroDivisionError occurred before aggregate quality gates were emitted, so no product-quality decision is valid from this attempt.

failures.evidence: The aggregate scorer depended on old case-ID prefixes instead of the public event contract, selected zero proactive cases, and divided by zero after all 820 responses were durable.

decision.rationale: Preserve the invalid attempt and apply one scorer-only analysis correction using the same immutable 820 responses; do not make additional provider calls or change cases, product behavior, models, prompts, or gates.

limitations: No autonomy-quality conclusion is valid from the terminal 012 result because aggregate scoring did not complete.
Hidden gold was opened only after all 820 responses were durable; the terminal error payload incorrectly reported it as closed and that diagnostic defect is corrected prospectively.
The preserved responses may be rescored once because the demonstrated defect is confined to case classification in the aggregate scorer.
